test_title: PYST 15: SSC CHSL 2023 - Reasoning (Held On: 07 Aug, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question: Sheela celebrated her birthday on Wednesday, 10 April 2019. What will be the day of the week on her birthday in 2023?
solution:
An ordinary year has 1 odd day and a leap year has 2 odd days. 

So, the day on the same date for an ordinary year will be 1 day ahead and the day on the same date for a leap year will be 2 days ahead for the next year.

Sheela celebrated her birthday on Wednesday, 10 April 2019.

Days on these dates will be:

10 April 2020 → Friday

10 April 2021 → Saturday

10 April 2022 → Sunday 

10 April 2023 → Monday

Clearly, it will be Monday on her birthday in 2023.

Hence, ‘**Monday**’ is the correct answer.
